notes.title: Ver1.16更新（20250304）
notes.content:
1.修復玩家更新win11最新系統補丁後，遊戲會在某些情況下崩潰的問題。
2.增加遊戲的穩定性。
3.修正部分文字錯誤。

notes.title: UPDATE
notes.content:
1. Correct some translation errors.
2. In this version, mercenary troops can be directly commanded on one's side, and the mercenaries that have not been dismissed will order the heroes to act in accordance with the previous squad instructions in the allies.
3. Modified the coverage of clouds, troops will not be covered by clouds now.

notes.title: update 0427
notes.content:
1. Fix the problem that some dialogues in the academy cannot be switched to Chinese.
2. Fix the problem that the number of attacks is not displayed in the Japanese environment.

notes.title: Ver1.10 update
notes.content:
Ver1.10 update description
1. Add support for Japanese version, players can switch the game language to [Japanese] in the game now.
2. Fix known bugs.

notes.title: Ver 1.055 UPDATE
notes.content:
Version 1.055 revised content:

1. Optimized the logic of data loading, reducing the possibility of data reading
The chance of reporting an error due to insufficient memory.

2. Optimize the loading logic of BGM and reduce the load of reading.

notes.title: Ver 1.054 UPDATE
notes.content:
Version 1.054 revised content:

1. Fixed an issue where marking an enemy in certain specific situations would cause the game to jump out.

If you encounter any bugs that cannot continue the game, please post a screenshot to the discussion area. Thank you very much!

notes.title: Version 1.053 RELEASE
notes.content:
Version 1.053 revised content:

1. Restore the item maintenance function deleted in version 1.051.
2. Now the character action will not end after the squad command is issued.
3. Correct some typos.
4. Fixed an issue where Lilith may not be able to appear on the stage after defeating Lilith in the third level of the IF line.
5. The kanban girl in the synthesis room of the college is changed to [Zina].

notes.title: v1.051 UPDATE
notes.content:
◆ v1.051 revision content:
1. Fixed the error of character preparation, and deleted the part that may lead to jumping out.
2. Restored Pakistan's special skills.
3. Fixed some chronological errors.

notes.title: 0514 update
notes.content:
0514 update content:
1. Added Tomoe's IF story, a total of three chapters. It can be opened in the branch task of the academy after chapter 10 is cleared.
2. Fixed some errors in branch tasks.
3. Added instructions for opening branch tasks.
4. Added color display and description of advanced weapons and equipment.

notes.title: 0409UPDATE
notes.content:
This update:
1. Increase the animation effect switch at the beginning of the game and in the stronghold. Turning off the animation effect will effectively reduce the chance of getting stuck in the game.
2. In Chapter V [Lien Chan], the skills of mechanical guards were changed from [Commander] to [Soldier].
3. Fixed the bug that [Taunt Badge] is equipment and takes up the equipment bar. Now it is a consumable item.
Preview of next update:
         Because Ba classmates finally won in the vote, part of Ba ’s route will be restored in version 1.05 and her ending (IF line) will be increased.

notes.title: 0401UPDATE
notes.content:
1. A new branch level has been added. This branch level will be opened after the completion of [Demon Gate]. You can get the lockbox and the hero's swimsuit in this level. (Once obtained, you can change the hero costume during the Academy event)
2. Fixed the issue where [Lisse of Awakening] failed to hit the main character and caused Lilith to run around the wall.
3. Added the [Heroic] trait of Elnett, she can also gain experience after being defeated by the enemy commander.
4. Raised the upper limit of training points, currently the maximum is 200 points.
5. Added the password for Diani to join, the password is [900006]. Commanders who encountered Diani before version 1.03 can reset her status through this password.
6. Corrected the non-essential mission conditions in [15 rounds] in hard mode. Now these missions all include 15 rounds.
7. Fixed some text errors.

notes.title: 0323UPDATE
notes.content:
1. Fixed the issue where Lord Otto's death prematurely caused Closfia to fail to activate properly in Will and Ambition, and reset the upper limit of Little Crowe.
2. Fixed an issue where the old flying dragon model would cause failure when playing an animation.
3. The momentary scene effect is temporarily turned off to alleviate the problem of getting stuck during the plot.
4. Fixed an issue where Diani may not be able to join.
==========
If you have any other plot points that are stuck after the update, or the combat animation is stuck, please write to the customer service email. We will correct it as soon as possible.

In order to express his apology, Crowe is going to put on the swimsuit issued by the college ... probably the next version will be apologized.

notes.title: 0321 Update
notes.content:
We will update on March 21 to fix some issues that players feedback, please pay attention to the update.
0321 updates are as follows:
1. In [Return], Closfia will not appear before the Mountain Thieves appear in advance.
2. Fixed an issue where some scenes might crash.
=======
If you still have flashback issues after updating, you can try the keyboard's [space] key to skip the event first. Then notify us through the customer service email to correct it. We are very sorry for this question!
3. Fixed the problem that Aixia Line may not be triggered.
